question: Related Questions Q. Is it permissible in Islam to collect monthly salary for Imam of a Masjid who have a limited source of income from muqtadi and the neighboring residents of a masjid? 7351 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 44985 Country: India Title: Construting Mosque ove septic tank Question: In our village there is a soakage pit. Whole of the drainage of the vicinity goes into it. May be refuse from human body like urine and faeces may also be entering it. It has a concrete slab over it. Can we construct a Masjid over it? If not, we can even afford to raise pillars on its corners and erect the mosque over the pillars above the ground level. The land in question (in which this soakage pit is located) belongs to a person and that person is ready to donate it. Please let me know and the precautions we should take. Answer ID: 44985 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1221/924/B=9/1434) First, get the pit allotted for mosque. Thereafter, you may construct mosque at the place after levelling it up and erecting columns at its four corners. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
